mapper.select: SELECT TEMP.FINPROD_ID finprodId, TEMP.B_CCY bCcy, TEMP.shartAmt, 0 AS branch, FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FPT.TYPE_12 type12 FROM (SELECT FINPROD_ID, B_CCY, SUM(SHARE_AMT) shartAmt FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION WHERE to_char(CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{benchDate} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID, B_CCY) TEMP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON TEMP.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID AND FPT.BRANCH = '0'
SELECT STRATEGY_ID strategyId, STRATEGY_NAME strategyName FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY WHERE STRATEGY_CLASS = #{strategy_class} AND USE_STATUS = #{use_status}

select #{negate} as IS_INNOVATION, PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO.PRD_DESIGN_ID as PRD_DESIGN_ID, PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME as PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME, round(BOK_POSITION_PRD.TDY_SHARE_AMT / 10000.2) as TDY_SHARE_AMT, FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE as ACTMDATE, round(TEMP.continueShare / 10000, 2) as productDueShares from PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO.PRD_DESIGN_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PRD_DESIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID is null AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = BOK_POSITION_PRD.FINPROD_ID AND BOK_POSITION_PRD.BRANCH = 0 AND BOK_POSITION_PRD.CDATE = #{cdate} LEFT JOIN (select SUM(case when TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS IN (#{strongShareIncrease},#{productSubscription},#{productPurchase},#{productDividendsInto}) then TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SHARE_AMT else -1 * TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SHARE_AMT end as SHARE_AMT) continueShare, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID as FINPROD_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = #{negate} AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus} AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.BUSI_TYPE IN (#{monetaryTransaction}, #{netWorthTransaction}, #{expectedReturnTrading}) AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_DATE <= #{startDate} AND TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS IN (#{productPurchase},#{productSubscription},#{productRedemption},#{earlyRedemptionOfProducts},#{redemptionOfProductsInDefault},#{productMaturity},#{earlyTermination},#{productReturnInTheMiddle},#{tradeStatus},#{strongShareIncrease},#{shareStrongBy}) group by TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID ) TEMP ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = TEMP.FINPROD_ID

SELECT prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_seris_id prdPlanSerisId, prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_seris_name prdPlanSerisName, prd_plan_detail.plan_target_amt/10000 as planTargetAmt, prd_plan_detail.plan_change_amt/10000 as planChangeAmt,
case when prd_plan_detail.is_new = 'Y' then '是' when prd_plan_detail.is_new = 'N' then '否' else '' end as isNew
FROM prd_plan_detail left join prd_plan_info ON prd_plan_detail.prd_plan_code = prd_plan_info.prd_plan_code WHERE prd_plan_detail.plan_change_amt > 0
and prd_plan_info.vdate = to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and prd_plan_info.edate = to_date(#{edate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
SELECT STRATEGY_ID id, STRATEGY_NAME text FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY WHERE STRATEGY_CLASS = #{strategy_class} AND USE_STATUS = #{use_status}
